prompt_text: I need new tires installed in Pleasanton. Which specific tire shops should I call, and why?
q1_prompt_text: Where should I buy tires in Pleasanton CA and who does the best installation?
answer_verbatim:
I can do that — first I need two quick clarifying items so I give you accurate, actionable shop recommendations:

1) Which Pleasanton do you mean (Pleasanton, CA or another Pleasanton)?  
2) Tell me your vehicle (make/model/year) or the tire size (example: 225/50R17), and any preferences (brand you want, budget, membership like Costco, need alignment or TPMS service, same-day install).

If you want a fast answer without those details, I can still give general guidance now:
- Call national chains if you want predictable pricing, wide inventory, and quick appointments: Discount Tire (great selection and mount/balance service), Costco Tire Center (best value on many brand tires if you’re a member), Firestone Complete Auto Care or Goodyear/NTB/Pep Boys (good warranties and alignment packages).
- Call a reputable local independent shop if you prefer personalized service or supporting local business — independents often match prices and may include perks (free rotation, quicker appointment slots).
- When you call any shop, ask: Do you have my tire size in stock? Is mounting/balancing included? Do you charge a disposal or TPMS fee? Is an alignment included or available (and cost)? What is the warranty/road-hazard coverage? How soon can you install?

If you confirm the Pleasanton and your tire/vehicle details I’ll list 4–6 specific shops (name, phone, address, why to call each) and highlight best options for budget, performance tires, or same-day installs. Which Pleasanton and what tires do you need?
